get_current_sun_phase.description: Find out where the sun is at this moment at a place: whether it is daylight, twilight or night, whether the golden or blue hour is running, and which event is due next and in how many minutes. This is the check to branch a schedule on: switch something on at dusk, or send a reminder half an hour before sunset.

get_day_length.description: Get how long the day is at a place, and how that compares with the day before: the seconds gained or lost, and whether the days are lengthening or shortening. Use it to track the turn of the seasons, or to send a note when the evenings start drawing in.

get_golden_hour.description: Get the golden hour and blue hour windows for a place on one day: morning and evening, each with the minutes it lasts. The golden hour is the warm light just after sunrise and before sunset; the blue hour is the deep-blue sky either side of it. Neither is really an hour: the length is worked out for the day and place you ask about.

get_moon_times.description: Get the moon for a place on one day: when it rises and sets, its phase by name, and how much of it looks lit, as a percentage. About one day a month the moon does not rise, and another it does not set, within the local day; the response says which, rather than leaving a blank time unexplained.

Each bearing comes as degrees from north and as the compass direction it points to, and the noon altitude says how high the sun climbs: what you need to aim a camera, place a solar panel, or work out which windows get the light.

get_twilight_times.description: Get dawn, dusk and the three twilights for a place on one day, grouped into the morning and evening runs they belong to: first light, then nautical, then civil twilight, then sunrise, and back out the other way after sunset. Civil twilight is when it is light enough to be outdoors without a lamp; after astronomical twilight the sky is fully dark.

description: Look up sunrise and sunset times anywhere on Earth with the keyless Sunrise Sunset API. Get sun and moon events for a day or a whole year, the golden and blue hours for a shoot, dawn, dusk and the three twilights, the sun's compass bearing and height in the sky, how the day length is changing, and whether it is light out right now. Times come in the location's own timezone. No account or API key is required; showing a link to sunrise-sunset.org is.
